answer.summary: No prior evidence supports emergent memory mechanisms in low-variation, stable input environments without predefined feature vectors.
answer.content: The available data from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 contains no explicit or implicit indicators of memory systems exhibiting temporal continuity, clustering, or coherence under stable conditions. A new, narrowly focused inquiry is required to probe for any reported use of temporal smoothing or state interpolation as a proxy for memory persistence in absence of structured features.

answer.lesson: Memory coherence under stable conditions cannot be inferred from featureless sequence analysis; direct evidence of temporal smoothing or interpolation is required to establish implicit continuity mechanisms in agent memory systems without predefined structure or vectors.
